items.title_zh: 比哈尔邦医院用纸板给一名男子骨折的腿打石膏
items.title_en: Bihar Hospital Uses Cardboard To Plaster Fractured Leg Of A Man
items.summary_zh: 受伤男子说，在他被转移到穆扎法尔布尔的什里克里希纳医学院和医院后，没有医生来看望他。
items.summary_en: The injured man said that no doctor visited him after he was shifted to Shree Krishna Medical College and Hospital in Muzaffarpur.

items.title_zh: 喀拉拉邦友好的野象 Chillikomban 因其对芒果的热爱而走红
items.title_en: Chillikomban, Kerala's Friendly Wild Elephant, Goes Viral For His Love For Mangoes
items.summary_zh: 居住在喀拉拉邦帕拉卡德 (Palakkad) 内利亚姆帕蒂 (Nelliyampathy) 森林中的奇利孔班 (Chillikomban) 更喜欢踏上森林边界，品尝芒果和菠萝蜜。
items.summary_en: Living in the forests of Nelliyampathy in Palakkad, Kerala, Chillikomban prefers to tread the forest borders to enjoy mangoes and jackfruits.
